copy_frame: Copy world-space animation from the selected time range, or from the visible playback range when no range is selected.
copy_range: Copy world-space animation from the selected time range, or from the visible playback range when no range is selected.
paste_frame: Paste the copied world-space transforms onto the selected objects at the current frame.
paste_animation: Paste copied world-space animation onto the selected objects while preserving the captured timing.
help: Open the World Space copy and paste documentation.
